deadline.value: International applicants should apply by February 1, 2027 for priority review; the standard deadline is June 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Fall - Priority U.S. CITIZEN February 1 INTERNATIONAL February 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: GRE General is required if you enter with a bachelor's from a university other than Texas State; it is not required for Texas State graduates or those with an electrical engineering master's.
gre_general.quote: the applicant must have an official Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general test result report submitted to The Graduate College if entering with a bachelor's degree from any university other than Texas State University

also.quote: official GRE (general test only) with competitive scores in verbal, quantitative reasoning and writing sections (required if entering from any university other than Texas State University)

supervisor.value: Admission does not need a supervisor; the program director is the initial advisor for each admitted student.
supervisor.quote: The Ph.D. program director serves as the initial advisor of each student accepted into the program

funding.value: Paid assistantships are limited in number.
funding.quote: A limited number of paid graduate assistantships are available

entry_route.value: Most applicants should hold a master's; exceptional bachelor's applicants are considered but must complete 24 extra master's-level hours.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have completed a master’s degree in electrical engineering or a closely related discipline from an accredited college or university | Exceptional applicants with a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a competitive GPA
